name: gtfs-validator
description: GTFS validation and feed analysis powered by GTFS Analyzer.

interface.longDescription: Validate uploaded GTFS Schedule ZIP files and public feed URLs with the GTFS Analyzer engine.
defaultPrompt: Validate this GTFS feed and summarize publishability, scores, and highest-impact findings.
Explain this GTFS rule and how to fix it.

positive.prompt: Validate the attached GTFS ZIP and summarize its publishability and scores.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the validator status, publishability, scores, severity counts, feed metrics, and prioritized findings.

positive.prompt: Analyze this public GTFS ZIP URL and summarize the result: https://gtfs.vta.org/gtfs_vta.zip
positive.expected_behavior: Analyze the public URL and return status, input mode, publishability, scores, metrics, and prioritized findings.

positive.prompt: Explain the GTFS rule TRP_002 and how to fix it.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the canonical rule ID, severity, class, authority source, title, and remediation metadata.

positive.prompt: For this GTFS validation result, summarize the highest-impact findings in priority order.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the validator's finding order and summarize the highest-impact notices without recalculating scores.

positive.description: Explain a validation result in Turkish
positive.prompt: Bu GTFS doğrulama sonucunu Türkçe özetle ve en önemli düzeltmeleri sırala.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a Turkish summary while preserving the validator's status, scores, severity counts, and finding order.

negative.prompt: Analyze this private network URL: http://127.0.0.1/feed.zip

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of GTFS feed validation and rule lookup.
